name: Box Ridge
blurb: Long crest on Box Canyon's northeast flank, rising from forest above Kachess Lake to the crags of Lobox and Hibox, whose name marks the high point.

name: Hibox Mountain
blurb: Box Ridge's high point, as the name says; a steep, rooty climbers' path leaves the Rachel Lake trail for a short Class 3 scramble up the east ridge.

name: Alta Mountain
blurb: Rocky summit reached by a climbers' path off the Lila Lake trail, up a narrow south ridge with Rachel and the Rampart Lakes spread below.

name: Rachel Lake
blurb: Old growth and avalanche brush line Box Canyon Creek before a rooty, relentless final mile to this lake beneath Rampart Ridge, springboard for Lila and Rampart Lakes.
facts: type: alpine lake | elevation_m: 1422 | area_km2: 0.1016 | gain_m: 670.6

name: Lila Lake
blurb: A slim island floats in this small parkland tarn high on Alta Mountain's south flank, where Rampart Ridge ends and Hibox Mountain fills the view to the east.
facts: type: alpine lake | elevation_m: 1584 | area_km2: 0.01133 | gain_m: 853.4

name: Rampart Lakes
blurb: A scatter of tarns on a bench beneath the crest of Rampart Ridge, perched above Rachel Lake, with huckleberries and a tangle of boot paths between them.
